## Explanation

Kth largest → min-heap
Suppose:

nums = [3,2,1,5,6,4]
k = 2

We want the 2nd largest:

6 → largest
5 → 2nd largest

Use a min-heap of size k.

The idea is->Keep only the k largest elements seen so far.
